newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KGHM to invest $800 mln over five years.
newsitem.headline: Polish KGHM to invest $800 mln over five years.

text.p: A development plan of Poland's KGHM copper concern envisages investment of $800 million over the next five years, a deputy KGHM president said on Thursday.

Jerzy Dobrzanski told a news conference that in 1997 and 1998 one third of the annual investment would be allocated for environmental protection. Investment in environmental protection would then start falling in 1999, he said.
"Under the five year plan we will spend a total of $800 million on investment. In 1996 we invested 550 million zlotys of which one third was for environmental protection," Dobrzanski said.
He declined to say how KGHM, slated for domestic and international flotation in mid-year, would finance the investment.

The net profit of KGHM tumbled to 147.2 million zlotys last year from a 481.9 million net profit in 1995 and the company dropped plans for a new share issue to increase capital together with or shortly after flotation.
